instruction: Insert the three tubes into the rack one by one.

arguments.note: Approach the left tube with clearance, aiming to grasp near its capped end so its tip remains free for insertion.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 36 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The first approach stopped short. Continue toward the tube while beginning to turn the jaws downward.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 23 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: Turn fully downward above the tube to localize the capped end before descending.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 23 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The tube runs diagonally away from its cap. Align the jaws across the upper body and approach just above contact.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The close view places the cap near the grasp point. Shift slightly onto the neck and rotate across rather than along the tube.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 25 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: Center the neck between the jaws using the wrist view, and lower to tube height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The neck is nearly centered. Make a few-millimetre correction and close the jaws around it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws have closed onto the neck. Lift the tube clear of the table before turning it upright.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tube lifted securely. Begin rotating its free tip downward while moving toward the rack at safe height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Complete the upright rotation and approach the left rack openings with the tube tip above the top plate.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 36 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The rotation and transfer stopped short. Finish the requested upright pose before judging slot alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The working hand hides the tube tip and rack. Bring the idle wrist above the rack for an independent alignment view.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 37 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: Continue the observing-wrist approach so the rack and held tube appear together.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The steeper viewing pose was unreachable. Finish the earlier, less rotated observing pose instead.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lower the upright tube toward the rack while turning the wrist to expose the leftmost opening from the side.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 18 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Tilt the observing wrist downward to compare the tube tip with the rack holes without the working hand blocking them.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The tip appears left of the first large opening. Shift toward that opening while keeping the tip above the rack.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Begin a cautious five-millimetre descent while watching the tip relative to the leftmost opening.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The side view shows the tip behind the row of large holes. Move forward over the rack while maintaining the current clearance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tube shifted in the jaws during alignment, suggesting edge contact. Lift clear before making any further insertion attempt.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Aim the idle wrist toward the held tube so its inclination and the rack entrance can be seen together.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The observing wrist now shows the complete rack. Lower in free space to establish the tip's approach line before final alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The side view reveals that the tube is inclined. Restore the grasp-aligned wrist angle at clearance before attempting insertion.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 18 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: From the head view, align the exposed tip over the left rear large opening while retaining a small vertical clearance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tip is now immediately above a large opening. Descend five millimetres and check for contact or deflection.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Make a small lateral correction toward the opening center and descend another four millimetres.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Continue the millimetre-scale centering and insertion approach; the tube remains held and the rack is stationary.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tube appears to touch the near edge rather than enter. Hold height and shift four millimetres toward the opening center.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tip is better centered over the opening. Test entry with a five-millimetre descent.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tube is meeting the rim. Relieve contact and move a few millimetres toward the visible center of the opening.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The cap angle suggests the tube has tilted within the jaws. Lift slightly and correct that inclination before reseating the tip.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 126 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The planner took a large intermediate detour instead of the small correction. Move to a clearer pose away from the rack before retrying the orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 18 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: At the clear pose, make the small inclination correction separately from translation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Approach a central large opening with the corrected inclination, leaving clearance for final visual alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tip is over a central large slot in the observing view. Lower five millimetres to test entry.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Continue the controlled descent; the tip remains centered over the same slot.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lower another five millimetres, monitoring the tube for rim contact.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tip is entering the selected opening without visible lateral movement. Continue five millimetres downward.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tip is slightly beyond the opening center. Hold height and make a four-millimetre forward correction.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Try another five-millimetre descent after the centering correction.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tip continues into the opening with no visible rack displacement. Lower five millimetres further.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Continue seating the tube in small increments while retaining the current lateral alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lower another five millimetres to seat the tube more deeply, watching for resistance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tube is supported within the slot. Open the jaws to let it settle upright without pushing against the rim.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The last 5 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The first tube has settled into the rack. Withdraw the left hand and approach the next tube near its capped end with the right hand.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Use the right wrist view to align near the second tube's neck. Return the empty left arm toward its starting pose.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 35 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The close view puts the neck slightly right of the jaw center. Correct that offset and lower to just above grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws are over the cap. Shift down the tube onto its neck, leaving the free tip unobstructed.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Center on the neck just below the cap and close the jaws at tube height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The second tube is grasped near its cap. Lift clear before turning it upright.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The longer lift was refused. Use a shorter vertical lift to clear the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Begin turning the held tube tip downward while moving toward the rack with clearance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 22 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: Bring the second tube upright over an empty opening on the right side of the rack.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 31 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: Finish the interrupted alignment over the right-side slot, keeping the tip above the plate.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lower four millimetres into the right-side opening and check the tube for deflection.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The descent met resistance at the rim. Lift a few millimetres and recenter slightly inward before retrying.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Move the tip a few millimetres toward the front row while relieving rim contact.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Continue the small forward correction and test entry with a four-millimetre descent.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The corrected alignment permits descent. Lower another five millimetres into the slot.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Continue seating the second tube in five-millimetre increments.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tube is descending steadily within the slot. Lower another five millimetres before release.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The second tube is supported in the opening. Release it so it can settle fully into the rack.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The last 4 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The second tube has settled after release. Withdraw the empty right hand toward its starting pose, preserving the two placements.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Two tubes are upright in the rack; the third remains on the table. Use the remaining motion budget to return both empty arms toward their starting poses.
